newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder ups Chevron yr EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder ups Chevron yr EPS.

text.p: Schroder & Co analyst Michael Mayer has increased his 1997 earnings per share forecast for Chevron Corp to $4.25 from $4.05 after the company reported earnings per share of $1.28 in the second quarter, some $0.10-$0.15 above analyst forecasts.
He also initiated a 1998 forecast of $4.10 EPS.
"We forecast down earnings in 1998, with lower oil and gas prices and lower petrochemical margins more than offsetting solid production growth of about six percent," Mayer said.
He maintained his market perform rating for the stock and said it is at his target price of $76.
